sql.propToolZipCode.getAllForCompany: select f.id, f.zip_code, f.company_id, f.archived, f.active from props.zip_code f where f.company_id = :companyId and f.archived is not true order by f.zip_code
sql.propToolZipCode.insert: insert into props.zip_code(zip_code, company_id, active, created_by_id) values (:zipCode, :companyId, :active, :createdById)
sql.propToolZipCode.update: update props.zip_code set zip_code = :zipCode, active = :active, modified_by_id = :modifiedById, date_modified = now() where id = :id
sql.propToolZipCode.delete: update props.zip_code set archived = true, modified_by_id = :modifiedById, date_modified = now() where id = :id
